info.name: EduClick Metrics API
info.description: Postman collection for testing EduClick Metrics backend APIs. These APIs track course engagement actions (BUY / ENROLL) and provide aggregated metrics used for real-time dashboard visualization.

request.description: Sends a course interaction event to the backend. This request publishes the event to Kafka, which is then consumed and persisted in the database for analytics.
Fetches aggregated course engagement metrics. This API is consumed by the frontend dashboard to visualize BUY and ENROLL actions per course.
